reviews.review: I would regret it later but I would smash Huntress

One of the easiest recommendations of my life. Risk of Rain 2 is consistently a game I find myself going back to, and can't seem to put down. The loot and shoot aspect of the game provides a sense of real progression, as you build your character into an unstoppable force against infinitely increasingly difficult enemies. A run can last anywhere from 5 minutes to 5 hours, and each one plays out differently from the last, offering great replayability.

Characters are very well designed and each offers a unique playstyle, allowing the game to cater to anyone. Be it a fragile archer firing a rain of arrows into a swarm of enemies, a swordsman slashing through bosses up close and personal, or even a weird lizard dog thing that shoots poisonous projectiles, there's certain to be someone in this game for you.

Better yet, the game is constantly updating, with Hopoo Games offering developer insights every once and a while to keep you updated. Even if you unlock everything there is to offer right now(which is a lot), there's still more to experience in the future to come. If you find yourself in a content drought, fear not. It's incredibly easy to install mods, offering new characters and features to try out.

If you enjoy the game solo, the game becomes exponentially more fun with the inclusion of friends! Playing multiplayer is always a blast, while taking little away from the difficulty of the game. While some things can be frustrating, such as stealing your teammates items, or if the host disconnects, it disconnects all players, I can say that a 4 man squad is the way the game is meant to be played.

While I barely played any of Risk of Rain 1 on my friends computer over local co-op, I can't seem to put down this new installment in the series. If you're looking for a total time sink to lose yourself in, Risk of Rain 2 is absolutely for you.

This game makes you feel like an absolute god and then immediately kills you

10/10
Great rogue-like, one of my favorites. I'm excited for future content as well
